label: Backtesting Engines
description: The computational backbone — determines simulation fidelity, speed, and what types of strategies can be tested.

tools.label: Event-Driven Backtest
tools.description: Bar-by-bar / tick-by-tick with realistic order routing and fill logic

tools.label: Vectorised Backtest
tools.description: NumPy/Pandas array operations for ultra-fast parameter sweeps and prototyping

tools.label: Walk-Forward (Rolling Window)
tools.description: Rolls fixed-length train window forward, re-fitting and testing OOS

tools.label: Walk-Forward (Expanding Window)
tools.description: Expands training window cumulatively while testing on next OOS slice

tools.label: Out-of-Sample Holdout
tools.description: Reserves final calendar segment never seen during development

tools.label: Paper Trading / Live Simulation
tools.description: Forwards live data through strategy without real capital

tools.label: Multi-Asset Cross-Sectional
tools.description: Ranks/scores universe each period and allocates across instruments

tools.label: Intraday / Tick Backtest
tools.description: Sub-daily resolution with intraday session handling and microstructure

tools.label: Monte Carlo Backtest
tools.description: Reshuffles trade returns or blocks to build equity curve confidence intervals

tools.label: Synthetic Data Backtest
tools.description: Tests on generated paths (GBM, regime-switching, bootstrap) to stress robustness

tools.label: Multi-Timeframe Backtest
tools.description: Simultaneously consumes multiple bar frequencies (daily signal + hourly execution)

tools.label: Regime-Conditional Backtest
tools.description: Segments history by detected regimes and reports per-regime performance

label: Performance Analytics
description: The metrics defining whether a strategy is worth trading. CAGR, Sharpe, max drawdown, and profit factor are the minimum viable set.

tools.label: CAGR (Compound Annual Growth Rate)
tools.description: Annualised geometric return — the first number every investor asks for

tools.label: Sharpe Ratio
tools.description: Annualised excess return / annualised volatility — the universal risk-adjusted metric

tools.label: Sortino Ratio
tools.description: Excess return / downside deviation — penalises only harmful volatility

tools.label: Calmar Ratio
tools.description: Annualised return / max drawdown — return per unit worst-case pain

tools.label: Maximum Drawdown
tools.description: Largest peak-to-trough decline — the most important risk metric for traders

tools.label: Max Drawdown Duration
tools.description: Longest time below prior equity peak — measures psychological endurance

tools.label: Underwater Equity Curve
tools.description: Time series plot of current drawdown depth — the visual risk diagnostic

tools.label: Win Rate / Profit Factor / Payoff Ratio
tools.description: Basic trade quality measures (% profitable, gross P / gross L, avg win / avg loss)

tools.label: Expectancy
tools.description: Average P&L per trade = WR×AvgWin − LR×AvgLoss — expected value per trade

tools.label: Average Holding Period
tools.description: Mean duration from entry to exit — classifies strategy timeframe

tools.label: Hit Rate by Period
tools.description: Monthly / quarterly / yearly win percentage — investors evaluate at these horizons

tools.label: Historical VaR
tools.description: Percentile-based Value-at-Risk from empirical return distribution

tools.label: CVaR / Expected Shortfall
tools.description: Expected loss given loss exceeds VaR — coherent tail risk measure

tools.label: Rolling Sharpe / Vol / Beta
tools.description: Trailing-window metrics tracking performance stability over time

tools.label: Alpha / Beta (Jensen's)
tools.description: Benchmark-relative decomposition into skill and market exposure

tools.label: Information Ratio
tools.description: Active return / tracking error relative to benchmark

tools.label: Portfolio Turnover
tools.description: Fraction of portfolio traded per period — key cost and capacity driver

tools.label: Brinson-Fachler Attribution
tools.description: Decomposes active return into allocation, selection, and interaction effects

tools.label: Factor-Based Attribution
tools.description: Decomposes returns into factor exposures × factor returns + alpha residual

tools.label: Omega Ratio
tools.description: Probability-weighted gains vs. losses — captures full distribution shape

tools.label: Treynor Ratio
tools.description: Excess return per unit of systematic (beta) risk

tools.label: Gain-to-Pain Ratio
tools.description: Sum of all returns / absolute sum of negative returns

tools.label: Tail Ratio
tools.description: 95th percentile / 5th percentile of returns — distribution asymmetry

tools.label: Sterling / Burke / Kappa Ratios
tools.description: Alternative risk-adjusted metrics using drawdown or lower partial moments

tools.label: Ulcer / Pain Index
tools.description: RMS or mean of drawdown values — penalises both depth and duration

tools.label: Recovery Factor
tools.description: Net profit / max drawdown — measures recoverability

tools.label: Conditional Drawdown at Risk
tools.description: Expected drawdown in worst α% of episodes

tools.label: Up-Capture / Down-Capture
tools.description: Strategy's participation in benchmark up/down markets

tools.label: Tracking Error / Active Share
tools.description: Deviation from benchmark holdings and returns

tools.label: Capacity Estimation
tools.description: Max AUM before market impact erodes alpha

tools.label: Jobson-Korkie / Ledoit-Wolf Sharpe Test
tools.description: Statistical test for equality of Sharpe ratios between two strategies

label: Risk Management
description: Position sizing and risk controls separate surviving strategies from blown-up accounts.

tools.label: Kelly Criterion
tools.description: Optimal bet size maximising log-growth based on win rate and payoff

tools.label: Fractional Kelly (Half-Kelly)
tools.description: Scales Kelly by a fraction to reduce variance at modest growth cost

tools.label: Fixed Fractional Sizing
tools.description: Risks a fixed percentage of equity per trade

tools.label: Volatility Targeting
tools.description: Scales position inversely to realised vol to target constant portfolio volatility

tools.label: Fixed Stop-Loss
tools.description: Exits at predetermined price/percentage below entry

tools.label: Trailing Stop-Loss
tools.description: Ratchets stop upward with price, locking in gains

tools.label: Take-Profit Target
tools.description: Exits at pre-set profit level

tools.label: Drawdown Limit / Circuit Breaker
tools.description: Halts or reduces trading when drawdown hits threshold

tools.label: Gross / Net Exposure Limits
tools.description: Constrains total long+short and long−short as % of NAV

tools.label: Sector / Factor Exposure Limits
tools.description: Caps allocation to any single sector or factor tilt

tools.label: Volume Participation Limit
tools.description: Ensures trade size stays below % of ADV

tools.label: Canonical Scenario Library
tools.description: Pre-loaded stress scenarios: Black Monday 1987, LTCM 1998, GFC 2008, COVID 2020, SVB 2023, Yen Carry 2024

tools.label: Historical Scenario Replay
tools.description: Re-runs strategy through user-selected or canonical crises

tools.label: Margin / Leverage Monitor
tools.description: Tracks used vs. available margin and gross leverage over time

tools.label: Risk Parity Sizing
tools.description: Allocates risk equally across assets using inverse-vol or covariance weights

tools.label: ATR-Based Sizing
tools.description: Uses Average True Range for position size and stop distance

tools.label: Volatility-Based Stop
tools.description: Sets stop distance as multiple of ATR or rolling σ

tools.label: Time Stop
tools.description: Exits after maximum holding period regardless of P&L

tools.label: Correlation-Based Position Limits
tools.description: Rejects positions highly correlated to existing holdings

tools.label: Concentration Limit (HHI)
tools.description: Monitors Herfindahl index to prevent over-concentration

tools.label: Hypothetical Shock Test
tools.description: Applies user-defined shocks (−20% equity, +200bp rates) to portfolio

tools.label: Reverse Stress Test
tools.description: Finds the scenario causing a specified loss (e.g., −50% drawdown)

tools.label: Factor Stress Test
tools.description: Shocks individual risk factors and measures portfolio P&L impact

tools.label: Monte Carlo Forward Risk
tools.description: Simulates correlated future paths for prospective portfolio risk assessment

tools.label: Margin Call Simulator
tools.description: Models forced liquidation cascades when margin is breached

tools.label: Days-to-Liquidate
tools.description: Estimates days to unwind position at a given participation rate

tools.label: Equity Curve Trading
tools.description: Toggles strategy on/off based on its own equity curve vs. moving average

label: Overfitting Detection
description: The single most important category separating amateur from institutional quant work.

tools.label: Probability of Backtest Overfitting (PBO)
tools.description: CSCV framework estimating probability the best IS config was found by chance (Bailey et al.)

tools.label: Deflated Sharpe Ratio (DSR)
tools.description: Adjusts observed Sharpe for number of trials, skewness, and kurtosis (Bailey & De Prado)

tools.label: Walk-Forward Efficiency Ratio
tools.description: OOS Sharpe / IS Sharpe across folds — values near 1.0 indicate robustness

tools.label: Monte Carlo Permutation Test
tools.description: Shuffles returns to build null distribution and compute p-values for performance

tools.label: Purged k-Fold Cross-Validation
tools.description: Time-series CV removing leaked info between folds (De Prado)

tools.label: Parameter Stability Heatmap
tools.description: Visualises performance across parameter grid — smooth = robust, spiky = overfit

tools.label: Multiple Testing Corrections
tools.description: Bonferroni, Holm, BH-FDR — adjusts p-values when testing many strategies

tools.label: Block Bootstrap of Equity Curves
tools.description: Resamples return blocks preserving autocorrelation for stability assessment

tools.label: Minimum Backtest Length (MinBTL)
tools.description: Minimum sample size for a given Sharpe to be statistically significant

tools.label: White's Reality Check
tools.description: Bootstrap: is the best strategy significant after accounting for full search space?

tools.label: Hansen's SPA Test
tools.description: Improved Reality Check using studentised statistics for sharper power

tools.label: Haircut Sharpe Ratio
tools.description: Multiplicative haircut based on number of trials and data-mining bias

tools.label: Combinatorial Purged CV (CPCV)
tools.description: All combinatorial train/test splits with purging and embargo

tools.label: Regime-Conditional Validation
tools.description: Tests whether alpha persists across bull/bear/high-vol/low-vol regimes

tools.label: Synthetic Data Validation
tools.description: Evaluates on data with known properties to detect curve-fitting

label: Optimisation
description: Finding good parameters without finding noise.

tools.label: Grid Search
tools.description: Exhaustive sweep over parameter grid — simple, interpretable baseline

tools.label: Random Search
tools.description: Random parameter sampling — more efficient than grid in high dimensions

tools.label: Walk-Forward Optimisation
tools.description: Optimises on rolling IS windows, tests forward — gold standard approach

tools.label: Robust Optimisation
tools.description: Evaluates stability via sensitivity analysis and neighbourhood averaging

tools.label: Constraint Handling
tools.description: Enforces position limits, turnover, exposure bounds during optimisation

tools.label: Bayesian Optimisation (GP / TPE)
tools.description: Sequential model-based optimisation minimising function evaluations

tools.label: Genetic Algorithm / Evolutionary
tools.description: Population-based for complex non-convex landscapes

tools.label: CMA-ES
tools.description: Covariance Matrix Adaptation — state-of-the-art continuous black-box optimisation

tools.label: Differential Evolution
tools.description: Robust population-based optimiser for noisy objectives

tools.label: Particle Swarm
tools.description: Swarm intelligence for continuous parameter spaces

tools.label: Simulated Annealing
tools.description: Probabilistic optimiser escaping local optima via temperature schedule

tools.label: Multi-Objective Pareto
tools.description: Finds Pareto frontier trading off return vs. drawdown vs. other objectives

label: Objective Functions
description: The target metric the optimiser maximises or minimises.

tools.label: Maximise Sharpe Ratio
tools.description: Most common — optimises risk-adjusted return; sensitive to return distribution

tools.label: Maximise Sortino Ratio
tools.description: Penalises only downside vol — better for asymmetric strategies

tools.label: Maximise Calmar Ratio
tools.description: Optimises return per unit drawdown — preferred by CTAs and trend followers

tools.label: Minimise Maximum Drawdown
tools.description: Pure risk-reduction objective — conservative, can sacrifice upside

tools.label: Minimise CVaR / Expected Shortfall
tools.description: Tail-risk minimisation — penalises worst-case losses

tools.label: Target Volatility
tools.description: Optimises returns subject to constant volatility constraint

tools.label: Maximise Omega Ratio
tools.description: Threshold-based gain-loss ratio — captures full distribution shape

tools.label: Maximise Deflated Sharpe Ratio
tools.description: Optimises Sharpe adjusted for multiple testing — overfitting-resistant

tools.label: Custom Weighted Composite
tools.description: User-defined weighted combination (e.g., 0.5×Sharpe + 0.3×Calmar − 0.2×MaxDD)

tools.label: Maximise Profit Factor
tools.description: Gross profit / gross loss — simple P&L efficiency objective

label: Execution & Microstructure
description: Bridges theoretical backtest and real-world P&L.

tools.label: Transaction Cost Analysis (TCA)
tools.description: Decomposes realised costs into spread, impact, timing, and opportunity

tools.label: Slippage Model (Fixed / % / Vol)
tools.description: Simulates price degradation between signal and fill

tools.label: Implementation Shortfall
tools.description: Total cost vs. decision price (Perold) — the true cost of execution

tools.label: TWAP / VWAP Simulator
tools.description: Simulates time/volume-weighted execution and their costs

tools.label: Bid-Ask Spread Analysis
tools.description: Analyses effective, quoted, and realised spreads

tools.label: Maker/Taker Fee Model
tools.description: Applies exchange-specific fee schedules to fill simulation

tools.label: Square-Root Impact Model
tools.description: Impact ∝ √(size/ADV) — widely calibrated empirically

tools.label: Almgren-Chriss Impact Model
tools.description: Separates permanent and temporary linear impact for optimal scheduling

tools.label: IS Optimal Scheduler
tools.description: Optimises trade schedule to minimise shortfall given risk aversion

tools.label: Fill Probability Model
tools.description: Estimates limit order fill likelihood based on queue, spread, vol

tools.label: Order Book Simulator
tools.description: Simulates LOB dynamics for microstructure research

tools.label: Latency Impact Analysis
tools.description: Models how execution delay degrades fills for speed-sensitive strategies

tools.label: Funding Rate / Carry Cost Model
tools.description: Models funding rates (crypto perps), borrow cost, margin interest as P&L drag

label: Portfolio Construction
description: Determines how capital is allocated across assets.

tools.label: Mean-Variance (Markowitz)
tools.description: Classical efficient frontier via quadratic programming

tools.label: Black-Litterman
tools.description: Bayesian framework blending equilibrium returns with analyst views

tools.label: Risk Parity / ERC
tools.description: Equal Risk Contribution — each asset contributes identical marginal risk

tools.label: Hierarchical Risk Parity (HRP)
tools.description: De Prado's clustering-based allocation avoiding covariance inversion

tools.label: Minimum Variance
tools.description: Minimises portfolio variance without return estimation

tools.label: Maximum Sharpe (Tangency)
tools.description: Highest return-per-unit-risk on the efficient frontier

tools.label: Equal Weight (1/N)
tools.description: Baseline allocation — surprisingly robust OOS benchmark

tools.label: Inverse Volatility
tools.description: Weights inversely proportional to realised vol

tools.label: Rebalancing Frequency Analysis
tools.description: Compares daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly rebalance cadences

tools.label: Maximum Diversification
tools.description: Maximises ratio of weighted volatilities to portfolio vol

tools.label: Kelly Criterion (Portfolio)
tools.description: Log-growth-optimal sizing extended to multi-asset

tools.label: Turnover-Constrained Optimisation
tools.description: Optimises subject to max turnover per period

tools.label: Factor-Constrained Optimisation
tools.description: Enforces bounds on factor exposures within optimisation

tools.label: Robust (Resampled Frontier)
tools.description: Michaud-style resampling to reduce estimation-error sensitivity

tools.label: Nested Clusters Optimisation (NCO)
tools.description: De Prado's clustering + within-cluster optimisation

tools.label: Tax-Loss Harvesting
tools.description: Identifies positions for tax-efficient selling while preserving exposure

tools.label: Transition Probabilities

tools.label: Triple-Barrier Labelling

tools.label: Meta-Labelling
tools.description: Secondary classifier predicting whether primary signal will be profitable

tools.label: Bet Sizing

tools.label: Fractional Differentiation

tools.label: Model Stacking / Blending

tools.label: Hyperparameter Tuning (Financial)

tools.label: Sample Weighting (Uniqueness)

tools.label: Learning Curve Diagnostics
